description: This file contains the implementation of the GrainCallCancellationManager class, which manages cancellation of grain calls in the Orleans distributed framework. It includes interfaces, data structures, and methods for handling remote and local cancellation requests, processing cluster membership updates, and managing worker tasks for cancellation queues.

classes.name: IGrainCallCancellationManagerSystemTarget
classes.description: Interface for remote cancellation of grain calls, allowing cancellation requests to be sent asynchronously.

classes.name: GrainCallCancellationRequest
classes.description: Data structure representing a request to cancel a specific grain call, including target and source grain IDs and a message ID.

classes.name: GrainCallCancellationManager
classes.description: Main class responsible for managing grain call cancellations, including handling local and remote requests, processing cluster membership updates, and managing worker tasks for cancellation queues.

methods.name: CancelCallsAsync
methods.description: Handles incoming cancellation requests by invoking the cancellation extension on target grains, either locally or via grain calls.

methods.name: SignalCancellation
methods.description: Signals a cancellation request to a specific silo and grain, creating or retrieving a worker to handle the request.

methods.name: ProcessMembershipUpdates
methods.description: Continuously monitors cluster membership changes and cancels requests for silos that are dead or no longer active.

methods.name: PumpCancellationQueue
methods.description: Processes queued cancellation requests for a specific silo, batching requests and sending them remotely.

methods.name: GetOrCreateWorker
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a worker task and channel for processing cancellation requests for a specific silo.

methods.name: RemoveWorker
methods.description: Removes and disposes of a worker associated with a specific silo.

methods.name: StartAsync
methods.description: Initial startup logic for the cancellation manager (no-op in this implementation).

methods.name: StopAsync
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down all worker tasks and cluster monitoring.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the cancellation manager to the silo lifecycle events for startup and shutdown.
